# ppfx02: make profiler records attributable to actors

Parent `6d5546f5817282fcc70b9d5d8a0ad3f80d45413f`, base bot `pi_phase-profile-01`; candidate `bots/pi_phase-profile-02/` only. This is a diagnostic correction, no optimization or policy change. Keep PPFX_ENABLED default0 and all prior bounded storage/cross-round behavior.

PC source review found a data contract problem before ON analysis: the official local ZIP's `team-a.stdout` is a merged raw team stream with NUL separators and no textual actor tag. Individual profiler VMs reuse scope IDs, so `PPFX [kind,id,...]` is insufficient to assign records or deduplicate retained crosses by actor. Do NOT assume an external engine actor label exists. It may exist in the binary replay, but current parser does not have it and must not invent ownership.

Exact fix: include the actual champion handle identity in EVERY emitted PPFX record, including entries, exits, retained cross copies, aggregate summaries and final trailers. Suggested wire format `PPFX <actor_id> [existing numeric array unchanged]`. Obtain the identity once per safe_point drain outside the hot scopes, only after the current early no-data/final-sent returns and only in ENABLED code. Use the public `self()` champion handle cast, not hidden observations or an assumed slot/name. Do not sample actor identity for every scope and do not change event IDs, window, buffer, mask, output limit, thresholds or decisions. Avoid a new SDK query per emitted line if one cached local value per drain suffices.

Update implementation report/schema and source hashes. Run inherited native profiler tests/OFF preprocessing identity check and enabled syntax check; add a meaningful output-contract check if feasible without restructuring the profiler. Explain that obtaining identity/draining still has instrumentation cost and ON is not release evidence. Only source change should be enabled output tagging plus its docs/tests; report any unexpected required change.

PC will first build OFF and require original frozen WASM identity or investigate differences, then compile ON with `-DPPFX_ENABLED=1` via CMake compiler flags (no source mutation if possible). First fixture remains00swirl both sides vs frozen C02 at normal fuel. Parse records by actor+scopeID, require complete trailers or explicitly mark missing/overflow evidence, compare early event trajectories with original. No strength tournament, upload or ranked changes. Leave commit/push to bridge.
